description: Create a rail-signed WL-R-XXXXXX referral code, permanently attribute your own wallet with a signed code_token, inspect earnings, claim USDC, or verify a signed referral receipt. POST /api/referral-rail. Every call requires X-Wever-Wallet-Proof signed by the caller wallet and bound to the exact request body. Attribution requires the referee wallet proof, rejects self-referrals and permits only the first code. Earnings accrue from verified real payment and settlement records: 20 percent of eligible USDC paid for 12 months from the first attributed paid call. Claims reserve earnings and create a linked payout instruction for the authenticated referrer wallet, require a stable claim_id for retries, and allow 1.00 to 25.00 USDC per claim. The treasury holder uses wever_payout-authorize and wever_payout-execute with AP2 holder binding v2 and separate EIP-712 spending consent. The dedicated payout wallet requires manual funding; the shared payout cap is 100 USDC per UTC day. Retry the original claim after execution to reconcile the confirmed transfer and obtain its receipt. Total outstanding accruals are capped at 200.00 USDC and fail closed beyond that cap. Attributions and confirmed payouts return record-backed, verifiable signed receipts. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base mainnet using x402 exact, under the existing shared 10 signed-wallet free calls over rolling 30 days. The payout wallet does not receive API fees or escrow principal. Read the backend 402 body and /api/referral-contract for the exact contract and public verification key. This adapter forwards only caller-supplied credentials and grants no spending authority.
name: wever_referral-rail
title: Referral rail
